title: Price's autobiography
summary: He describes working on his book and keeping the notes disjointed.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: What you're reading there is from your autobiography.

Yeah, yeah. I been working on it where that now, if I wanted to, I could put it out tomorrow. All I'd do is just get a (unintelligible) secretaries and type it. But I keep it disjointed like this so that if somebody, you know, take it or swipe it they won't know what the hell it is. So I just don't keep it together, you know, in sequence. So this is just some idea about how concerned I am about facts and about the overall picture.
